summary: First testing pass for fantm.ink AI book generation SaaS. Ran full backend regression (19/19 pytest passing) and end-to-end browser automation covering: register → dashboard → wizard → book generation (real Groq ~87s, 5 coherent chapters, 870+ words each) → reader → free-tier gating (edit + PDF both trigger UpgradeModal) → Stripe checkout ($9.99/mo premium page loaded from checkout.stripe.com) → payment/success + payment/cancel routes → login → logout. All critical flows PASS. AI (Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile) verified end-to-end with real coherent output; Stripe verified with real test-mode checkout URL and page render. Illustrations 'coming soon' placeholder as expected (deferred scope).

minor.issue: Invalid lookup_key returns HTTP 500 with detail 'Price not found: ...' — should be 400 Bad Request since it's client input. Not blocking.
Rate-limit lockout is keyed by ip:email and only applied on login, not on register — acceptable but consider register enumeration guard.

issues: Retro-futuristic-spooky theme intact: CRT green #39FF14 on black, red accent for Upgrade CTA, 0px border radius, Space Mono + Cormorant Garamond, scanline/grain overlay present, sharp contrast. No design issues found.

action_items: (optional) Return 400 instead of 500 for unknown Stripe lookup_key in POST /api/payments/checkout.
(informational, not a bug) Illustrations feature intentionally deferred — 'illustrations coming soon' placeholder rendered in reader as spec'd; no action needed until xAI/Grok image key is added.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py set_auth_cookies uses secure=True and samesite='none' — correct for cross-origin preview deploy; cookies successfully round-tripped in browser during the E2E run.
books.py serialize_book and serialize_chapter correctly omit MongoDB _id and expose string id. No ObjectId leak.
books.py free-tier check compares count only for non-premium users; correct order (limit before length check).
Frontend Dashboard preemptively gates 2nd-book click by opening UpgradeModal (books.length >= 1) — good UX; backend still enforces (verified 403).
generation.py running_summary + characters + plot_threads are threaded per chapter — verified by inspecting generated Ch1..Ch5 coherence (same characters, resolved plot threads).
payments.py invalid lookup_key returns 500 (should be 400). Also, GET /api/payments/status polls Stripe as a fallback which is good for webhook-less previews.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (~4s runtime, 19 tests, all pass). It exercises auth, free-tier gating, book listing, chapter listing, PDF/edit 403, Stripe checkout URL. When testing Groq generation end-to-end, budget ~90s. When testing full paid Stripe checkout, use test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with a fresh registered user (existing users may already be premium after prior tests). Illustrations feature is intentionally deferred; do not report the 'coming soon' placeholder as a bug.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issues. Only minor RCA: /api/payments/checkout returning 500 for unknown lookup_key stems from stripe.Price.list() returning empty and the handler raising HTTPException(500, ...) — should be reclassified as HTTPException(400, ...) since it's client-supplied input. Trivial one-line change.
